publications.title: Thirty First Meeting of the Standing Advisory Committee (SAC) to Review the Flow of Credit to the MSME Sector in Kolkata on November 27, 2026
publications.summary: The 31st meeting of the Standing Advisory Committee (SAC) to review the flow of credit to micro, small and medium enterprises (MSMEs) was held in Kolkata on November 27, 2026. Shri Swaminathan J, Deputy Governor, Reserve Bank of India (RBI), chaired the meeting. Participants included the Additional Secretary and Development Commissioner, Ministry of MSME, and the Joint Secretary, Department of Financial Services, Ministry of Finance. Managing directors and executive directors of select banks, heads of SIDBI, NABARD, CGTMSE, NCGTC and KVIC, the Chief Executive Officer of the Indian Banks' Association, and representatives of national, regional and state-level MSME associations also attended. Recognising MSMEs' contribution to India's economy and development goals, the Deputy Governor urged banks to expedite credit sanctions and reduce reliance on collateral through cash-flow-based lending
